title: Design system token usage
description: Which tokens each component, primitive and layout reads, directly or through the system parts it composes, and what each token resolves to. Generated by scripts/token-usage.ts into token-usage.json; tests/unit/token-usage.test.ts fails when the committed file is stale or stops matching this schema.

$comment.description: Provenance: what generated the file and how to regenerate it.

units.description: One entry per folder in src/primitives, src/components and src/layouts, keyed by folder name (the last segment of the unit's Storybook title).

kind.description: The layer the unit belongs to.

exports.description: Names the public entry exports from this folder (values only, not types). Empty for internal units such as Field and Icon.

composes.description: Units this one imports directly (static value imports).

composesAll.description: Every unit reached through composition, transitively. Slot and children content passed in by the caller is not included.

tokens.description: Every token the unit reads, itself or through composition, sorted by token path.

token.description: Dotted token path; a key of the top-level tokens object.

readBy.description: Which unit reads it, and how.

unit.description: This unit, or one it composes.

how.description: css: a var() in the unit's stylesheet. prop: one of a token family selected by a prop (vars.space.gap[gap]).

tokens.description: Every token read by any unit, keyed by dotted path.

description.description: The token's $description, or its nearest group's.

value.description: The base (light) value as CSS text, aliases resolved.

chain.description: The alias chain from this token down to the raw value, e.g. [button.primary.bg, color.action.primary, color.indigo.600].

modes.description: Values in other modes, only for modes the token or its chain defines: dark (colour scheme), reduced-motion.
